text_block_list.name: Sales Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here's your fifty liters of fresh cream.
Thank you
for your patronage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thanks! See you again soon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm free today, so the academy has
asked me to
chaperone a few of the
students' trip to the
farmer's market.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This cream will help us make an
absolutely buono
cake! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! As a princess,
I hope to learn a
great
deal today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my prince fall head over heels
over head
again with a homemade
wedding cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That sounds truly buono! ☆ I'll teach you

everything you need to know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fifty liters of cream is quite the sight,
truth be
told.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We're going to use it all to make a
ginormous wedding cake. 'Cause if
you're gonna bake, why
not bake
big?! ☆
choice_data_list: What are you going to do with all ...
What are you going to do with all ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I try to calculate just how big this
cake is going
to be...

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Heyyy! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's one of the farmers. What's
going on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: STOMP, STOMP, STOMP!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! It's a bull! And it's coming this
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A bull with bloodshot eyes charges
towards us. There's no time to hesitate.
As I desperately try
to get the students
out of harm's way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, my! What a feisty little fella!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Akebono?! Why are you just standing
there?!
You'll be sent flying!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fiiine! Come on, cutie, show me
whatcha
got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alley-oop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono grapples the bull straight
on, then
lifts its massive body up off the
ground!

text_block_list.name: Escaped Bull
text_block_list.text: MOO?! MOOOOO?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
How is she that powerful?! Even the
bull's
bamboozled!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono. ♪ There, there, Mr. Bull. Be a
good boy
and calm down now.
choice_data_list: Those moves... don't tell me, sumo?!

text_block_list.name: Escaped Bull
text_block_list.text: Moo...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: She's calming it down with a hug!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait! ☆ I had to take Mr.
Bull back
to his home!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Akebono! I feel so
inspired
right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Maybe one day I'll be strong enough to
stop an
out-of-control car with my
prince inside!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please! Teach me your ways! Take me on
as your
pupil!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sure, no problem! First, if you want to
get bigger,
the hearty hot pot sumo
wrestlers eat is probably
the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
After we're done baking, let's celebrate
your
initiation with some hot pot and
cake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell them that all that food sounds like
too much
for just two people.
choice_data_list: Why not learn some real sumo techn...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you may be right. I have a pretty big

appetite, but Kawakami might struggle
with those
portions...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Why don't we invite everyone from
our dorm
to eat with us?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! I'll do whatever I can to
help! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I can't wait to cook! Let's go buy
some
ingredients on our way back
home! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow after the enthusiastic pair and
help them
pick out ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, everyone in Ritto
Dorm is clutching their stomachs in pain.
It's pretty clear that Hishi Akebono went
overboard with her
cooking again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's going to take more than a single
night for
Kawakami Princess to reach
bull-hoisting Hishi
Akebono's level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that if she's serious, it'd
probably be
better to practice some real
sumo wrestler
techniques.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see... Speaking of which, who taught
you your
moves, Akebono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've always been a fan of sumo. As a
kid, I'd
watch them training on TV, then
try to mimic their
moves!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I can teach you some of the
easier stuff
right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them sumo stomp all
the way
back to school...
